# Odette Pullen

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** Teacher  <sub>[v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v2 c28 P3](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0003), [v3 c18 P3](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0003)</sub>

## Appearance

She has a tranquil, pleasant, rosy-faced appearance. During her wedding, she wore white satin, tulle, lace, roses, orange blossoms, and was adorned with many diamonds.

_Sources: [v3 c41 P9](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0009), [v4 c2 P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010)_

## Personality

Odette is tidy, good, steady, unadorned, hardworking, and sensible. She is pragmatic, dutiful, and maintains a tranquil and gentle disposition that remains uncorrupted by wealth. She avoids speaking words that might injure the feelings of others and possesses considerable composure.

_Sources: [v1 c31 P30](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0030), [v1 c32 P18](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0018), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v2 c4 P8](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0008), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059), [v3 c2 P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004), [v4 c2 P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010)_

## Abilities

- Excellent at domestic science and cooking  <sub>[v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v3 c39 P27](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0027)</sub>

## Goals

- To earn her pay, satisfy the school board, and be placed on the School Inspector's Roll of Honor  <sub>[v2 c4 P2](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0002)</sub>

## History

Odette grew up in Brierley and attended school alongside Nell Harcourt and Isolde Pembroke. She joined the Regent's class to study for the Entrance exam, qualifying as a teacher at Regent's Academy. During her school years, she was a member of the all-female Story Club and the Brierley Village Improvement Society (B.V.I.S.), serving on its hall renovation committee. She taught at the Stonebridge school before returning to take over the Brierley school after Nell's departure. Later, she accepted a teaching position out on the western prairies. During a winter holiday back in Brierley, she attempted to propose marriage to Nell on behalf of her bashful brother Barney, which Nell declined. While teaching in the West, she met and became engaged to Mr. Inglis, a wealthy Englishman from Winnipeg. They married in Brierley, attended by a large family gathering, and went to Europe for their honeymoon before taking up residence in a mansion in Winnipeg.

_Sources: [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c32 P16](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0016), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v2 c6 P10](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0010), [v2 c28 P3](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0003), [v3 c8 P1](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0001), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P25](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0025), [v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030), [v3 c18 P3](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0003), [v3 c39 P18](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0018), [v3 c39 P20](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0020), [v3 c39 P27](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0027), [v3 c41 P5](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0005), [v3 c41 P6](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0006), [v3 c41 P9](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0009)_

> Now, she’s completely prepared.
